summary: Plains All American Pipeline filed an 8-K on September 8, 2026, furnishing unaudited pro forma condensed combined financials under Items 2.02 and 8.01, giving effect to its completed acquisition of EPIC Crude Holdings. The filing recaps the October 1, 2025 purchase of a 55% non-operated stake and the November 1, 2025 purchase of the remaining 45%, combining for full ownership, as if closed January 1, 2025. No new deal terms, price, premium, or board recommendation are disclosed; the filing is a routine pro forma update on an already-closed transaction, not itself a special situation.
